title: 4 ways to automate your video calls
summary: You're probably tired of video calls. So am I. But as much as you'd like to run and hide, they're not going anywhere. The good news is that the busywork around them doesn't have to land on you. Add Zapier to your AI assistant, tell your agent what should happen before and after your calls, and it builds the automation for you. Zapier runs it from there, even after you close the chat. And if you'd rather build in Zapier itself, you can do that too. Here's how it works. Table of contents: Build vi
